text: This chunk details the causes of cholera, emphasizing that it is caused by the bacterium *Vibrio cholerae*, which has over 200 serogroups. The most significant serogroups causing outbreaks are O1 and O139. The text also explains the transmission of the disease, primarily through contaminated water and food, and the role of flies as carriers. It describes the disease's progression within the body, the symptoms, and the incubation period, noting that the majority of infected individuals show no symptoms but can still spread the disease.
